name: Tar Creek Ambush
description: The banks of Tar Creek run thick with toxic, fluorescent orange water. Crumbling chat piles of mining waste loom on either side like man-made mountains, providing unstable cover. The air smells heavily of sulphur, blooming night-flowers, and rapid decay. Wuxing 'glass ghosts' occasionally flicker in the periphery, remnants of Thor strikes. Desperate, nanite-infused scavengers often use the chat piles to ambush those moving through the gully.

zones.name: Western Bank
zones.description: Muddy, unstable ground near a burnt-out drone husk. Offers moderate cover but makes running treacherous.

zones.name: The Creek
zones.description: Deep, fluorescent orange toxic water. Crossing takes twice as long and exposes combatants to toxic splashing.

zones.name: Eastern Chat Piles
zones.description: Steep hills of mining waste. Excellent vantage points and heavy cover, but the loose scree makes slipping easy.
